description:
An unlucky child. From the very beginning of her memories, life had always been harsh, and the start of her twenties began with bankruptcy. “Sign it. This is for you to buy some snacks.” A man who reached out to Nagyeom, trapped in the pit of debt, claiming to be her salvation. “I get that you’re excited now that life’s gotten better, but you still have to be careful, kid.” “……” “Listen while I’m being nice. Otherwise, you’ll be in big trouble.” It’s strange. The man with a dazzling smile blooming like a flower is nothing but beautiful—yet her instincts scream. Run. That man is dangerous. And yet, the man gently, and cunningly, slips into Nagyeom’s vulnerabilities. A beautiful person. A frightening person. And still… a good person. “Now Nagyeom will be thinking only about me again, right?” “……” “It’s okay. I think about you even more.” Nagyeom wants to know. What does this man want to do with her, and why is she so afraid of him?
